title: Cross Five Passes and Slay Six Generals
synopsis: Guan Yu learns of Liu Bei’s whereabouts and sets out to rejoin him, but faces many obstacles along the way.

series.title: Famous Sayings and Stories from the Three Kingdoms

fullText.simplified:
过五关，斩六将

    三国的时候，有一个很厉害的大英雄，名字叫关羽。他和“大哥”刘备一起为国家做事。有一次，他们被曹操打败了，两个人失散了。
    关羽保护着刘备的妻子，他们被曹操的人包围了。曹操很欣赏关羽，想让关羽为他工作。但是关羽说：“我只为我的大哥刘备工作。”曹操说：“现在你和刘备失散了，就先帮我工作吧。等以后你知道刘备在哪儿了，你可以去找他。”关羽同意了。
    关羽为曹操工作了一段时间，帮他做了不少事。曹操也送给关羽很多钱、房子和好马，希望关羽永远留下来。后来，关羽听说刘备在北方的一个城里。他马上去见曹操，说：“我知道我大哥在哪儿了，我要去找他了。”
    曹操没有说话，他心里很不愿意，但也没有说“不可以”。关羽担心曹操不让他走，所以他没有等待。他回去收拾行李，给曹操留了一封信，然后就带着刘备的妻子离开了。
    他们往北走，要经过五个城。这五个城都是曹操的，每个城的守将都听曹操的话。这些守将都问关羽：“你有没有曹操写的过关文书？如果没有，就不能过去。”
    曹操没有给关羽过关文书，所以关羽过不去。但他一定要过去。这些守将就和关羽打了起来。他们都想杀关羽，但关羽太厉害了，他们打不过关羽，最后都被关羽杀了。
    关羽走过五个城，杀了六个守将。最后，他终于带着刘备的妻子，找到了刘备。
    这就是关羽“过五关，斩六将”的故事。
    现在，“过五关，斩六将”是一个成语。它的字面意思是，过了五个关口，杀了六个大将。我们用这个成语来说，一个人经过很多难关，最后终于成功了。
    比如，你的朋友在找一份很好的工作。他先在网上通过了考试，然后参加了第一次面试，接着是第二次面试，最后还和公司的总经理见了面。他通过了所有这些难关，终于得到了这份工作。这时候，你就可以对他说：“恭喜你！这次找工作，你真是‘过五关，斩六将’啊！”
fullText.traditional:
過五關，斬六將

    三國的時候，有一個很厲害的大英雄，名字叫關羽。他和“大哥”劉備一起為國家做事。有一次，他們被曹操打敗了，兩個人失散了。
    關羽保護著劉備的妻子，他們被曹操的人包圍了。曹操很欣賞關羽，想讓關羽為他工作。但是關羽說：“我只為我的大哥劉備工作。”曹操說：“現在你和劉備失散了，就先幫我工作吧。等以後你知道劉備在哪兒了，你可以去找他。”關羽同意了。
    關羽為曹操工作了一段時間，幫他做了不少事。曹操也送給關羽很多錢、房子和好馬，希望關羽永遠留下來。後來，關羽聽說劉備在北方的一個城裡。他馬上去見曹操，說：“我知道我大哥在哪兒了，我要去找他了。”
    曹操沒有說話，他心裡很不願意，但也沒有說“不可以”。關羽擔心曹操不讓他走，所以他沒有等待。他回去收拾行李，給曹操留了一封信，然後就帶著劉備的妻子離開了。
    他們往北走，要經過五個城。這五個城都是曹操的，每個城的守將都聽曹操的話。這些守將都問關羽：“你有沒有曹操寫的過關文書？如果沒有，就不能過去。”
    曹操沒有給關羽過關文書，所以關羽過不去。但他一定要過去。這些守將就和關羽打了起來。他們都想殺關羽，但關羽太厲害了，他們打不過關羽，最後都被關羽殺了。
    關羽走過五個城，殺了六個守將。最後，他終於帶著劉備的妻子，找到了劉備。
    這就是關羽“過五關，斬六將”的故事。
    現在，“過五關，斬六將”是一個成語。它的字面意思是，過了五個關口，殺了六個大將。我們用這個成語來說，一個人經過很多難關，最後終於成功了。
    比如，你的朋友在找一份很好的工作。他先在網上通過了考試，然後參加了第一次面試，接著是第二次面試，最後還和公司的總經理見了面。他通過了所有這些難關，終於得到了這份工作。這時候，你就可以對他說：“恭喜你！這次找工作，你真是‘過五關，斬六將’啊！”

sentences.traditional: 三國的時候，有一個很厲害的大英雄，名字叫關羽。

sentences.english: During the Three Kingdoms period, there was a great and powerful hero named Guan Yu.

sentences.simplified: 他和“大哥”刘备一起为国家做事。
sentences.traditional: 他和“大哥”劉備一起為國家做事。
sentences.pinyin: tā hé dà gē liú bèi yì qǐ wèi guó jiā zuò shì
sentences.english: He worked for the country alongside his “eldest brother” Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 有一次，他们被曹操打败了，两个人失散了。
sentences.traditional: 有一次，他們被曹操打敗了，兩個人失散了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yí cì tā men bèi cáo cāo dǎ bài le liǎng ge rén shī sàn le
sentences.english: One time, they were defeated by Cao Cao, and the two became separated.

sentences.simplified: 关羽保护着刘备的妻子，他们被曹操的人包围了。
sentences.traditional: 關羽保護著劉備的妻子，他們被曹操的人包圍了。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ bǎo hù zhe liú bèi de qī zi tā men bèi cáo cāo de rén bāo wéi le
sentences.english: Guan Yu was protecting Liu Bei’s wives when they were surrounded by Cao Cao’s men.

sentences.simplified: 曹操很欣赏关羽，想让关羽为他工作。
sentences.traditional: 曹操很欣賞關羽，想讓關羽為他工作。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hěn xīn shǎng guān yǔ xiǎng ràng guān yǔ wèi tā gōng zuò
sentences.english: Cao Cao greatly admired Guan Yu and wanted Guan Yu to work for him.

sentences.simplified: 但是关羽说：“我只为我的大哥刘备工作。
sentences.traditional: 但是關羽說：“我只為我的大哥劉備工作。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì guān yǔ shuō wǒ zhǐ wèi wǒ de dà gē liú bèi gōng zuò
sentences.english: However, Guan Yu said, “I only work for my eldest brother Liu Bei.”

sentences.simplified: ”曹操说：“现在你和刘备失散了，就先帮我工作吧。
sentences.traditional: ”曹操說：“現在你和劉備失散了，就先幫我工作吧。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo shuō xiàn zài nǐ hé liú bèi shī sàn le jiù xiān bāng wǒ gōng zuò ba
sentences.english: Cao Cao said, “You and Liu Bei are separated for now, so work for me in the meantime.

sentences.simplified: 等以后你知道刘备在哪儿了，你可以去找他。”
sentences.traditional: 等以後你知道劉備在哪兒了，你可以去找他。”
sentences.pinyin: děng yǐ hòu nǐ zhī dào liú bèi zài nǎ'r le nǐ kě yǐ qù zhǎo tā
sentences.english: Later when you find out where Liu Bei is, you can go and look for him.”

sentences.simplified: 关羽同意了。
sentences.traditional: 關羽同意了。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ tóng yì le
sentences.english: Guan Yu agreed.

sentences.simplified: 关羽为曹操工作了一段时间，帮他做了不少事。
sentences.traditional: 關羽為曹操工作了一段時間，幫他做了不少事。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ wèi cáo cāo gōng zuò le yí duàn shí jiān bāng tā zuò le bù shǎo shì
sentences.english: Guan Yu worked for Cao Cao for a while and helped him with many things.

sentences.simplified: 曹操也送给关羽很多钱、房子和好马，希望关羽永远留下来。
sentences.traditional: 曹操也送給關羽很多錢、房子和好馬，希望關羽永遠留下來。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo yě sòng gěi guān yǔ hěn duō qián fáng zi hé hǎo mǎ xī wàng guān yǔ yǒng yuǎn liú xià lai
sentences.english: Cao Cao also gave Guan Yu a lot of money, houses, and good horses, hoping that Guan Yu would stay with him forever.

sentences.simplified: 后来，关羽听说刘备在北方的一个城里。
sentences.traditional: 後來，關羽聽說劉備在北方的一個城裡。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái guān yǔ tīng shuō liú bèi zài běi fāng de yí ge chéng lǐ
sentences.english: Later, Guan Yu heard that Liu Bei was in a city in the north.

sentences.simplified: 他马上去见曹操，说：“我知道我大哥在哪儿了，我要去找他了。”
sentences.traditional: 他馬上去見曹操，說：“我知道我大哥在哪兒了，我要去找他了。”
sentences.pinyin: tā mǎ shàng qù jiàn cáo cāo shuō wǒ zhī dào wǒ dà gē zài nǎ'r le wǒ yào qù zhǎo tā le
sentences.english: He immediately went to see Cao Cao and said, “I know where my eldest brother is. I’m going to find him.”

sentences.simplified: 曹操没有说话，他心里很不愿意，但也没有说“不可以”。
sentences.traditional: 曹操沒有說話，他心裡很不願意，但也沒有說“不可以”。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo méi yǒu shuō huà tā xīn lǐ hěn bú yuàn yì dàn yě méi yǒu shuō bù kě yǐ
sentences.english: Cao Cao said nothing. He was very unwilling in his heart, but he didn’t say “no”.

sentences.simplified: 关羽担心曹操不让他走，所以他没有等待。
sentences.traditional: 關羽擔心曹操不讓他走，所以他沒有等待。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ dān xīn cáo cāo bú ràng tā zǒu suǒ yǐ tā méi yǒu děng dài
sentences.english: Guan Yu was worried that Cao Cao would not let him leave, so he did not wait.

sentences.simplified: 他回去收拾行李，给曹操留了一封信，然后就带着刘备的妻子离开了。
sentences.traditional: 他回去收拾行李，給曹操留了一封信，然後就帶著劉備的妻子離開了。
sentences.pinyin: tā huí qù shōu shi xíng li gěi cáo cāo liú le yì fēng xìn rán hòu jiù dài zhe liú bèi de qī zi lí kāi le
sentences.english: He went back to pack his luggage, left a letter for Cao Cao, and then left with Liu Bei’s wives.

sentences.simplified: 他们往北走，要经过五个城。
sentences.traditional: 他們往北走，要經過五個城。
sentences.pinyin: tā men wǎng běi zǒu yào jīng guò wǔ ge chéng
sentences.english: They headed north and had to pass through five cities.

sentences.simplified: 这五个城都是曹操的，每个城的守将都听曹操的话。
sentences.traditional: 這五個城都是曹操的，每個城的守將都聽曹操的話。
sentences.pinyin: zhè wǔ ge chéng dōu shì cáo cāo de měi ge chéng de shǒu jiàng dōu tīng cáo cāo de huà
sentences.english: These five cities all belonged to Cao Cao, and the defending general of each city followed Cao Cao’s orders.

sentences.simplified: 这些守将都问关羽：“你有没有曹操写的过关文书？如果没有，就不能过去。”
sentences.traditional: 這些守將都問關羽：“你有沒有曹操寫的過關文書？如果沒有，就不能過去。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē shǒu jiàng dōu wèn guān yǔ nǐ yǒu méi yǒu cáo cāo xiě de guò guān wén shū rú guǒ méi yǒu jiù bù néng guò qù
sentences.english: Each defending general asked Guan Yu, “Do you have a travel pass written by Cao Cao? If not, you cannot pass.”

sentences.simplified: 曹操没有给关羽过关文书，所以关羽过不去。但他一定要过去。
sentences.traditional: 曹操沒有給關羽過關文書，所以關羽過不去。但他一定要過去。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo méi yǒu gěi guān yǔ guò guān wén shū suǒ yǐ guān yǔ guò bu qù dàn tā yí dìng yào guò qù
sentences.english: Cao Cao did not give Guan Yu a travel pass, so Guan Yu could not pass. But he was determined to pass.

sentences.simplified: 这些守将就和关羽打了起来。
sentences.traditional: 這些守將就和關羽打了起來。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē shǒu jiàng jiù hé guān yǔ dǎ le qǐ lái
sentences.english: The defending generals then started fighting with Guan Yu.

sentences.simplified: 他们都想杀关羽，但关羽太厉害了，
sentences.traditional: 他們都想殺關羽，但關羽太厲害了，
sentences.pinyin: tā men dōu xiǎng shā guān yǔ dàn guān yǔ tài lì hai le
sentences.english: They all wanted to kill Guan Yu, but Guan Yu was too powerful.

sentences.simplified: 他们打不过关羽，最后都被关羽杀了。
sentences.traditional: 他們打不過關羽，最後都被關羽殺了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dǎ bu guò guān yǔ zuì hòu dōu bèi guān yǔ shā le
sentences.english: None of them could defeat Guan Yu, and in the end, they were all killed by Guan Yu.

sentences.simplified: 关羽走过五个城，杀了六个守将。
sentences.traditional: 關羽走過五個城，殺了六個守將。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ zǒu guò wǔ ge chéng shā le liù ge shǒu jiāng
sentences.english: Guan Yu passed through five cities and killed six defending generals.

sentences.simplified: 最后，他终于带着刘备的妻子，找到了刘备。
sentences.traditional: 最後，他終於帶著劉備的妻子，找到了劉備。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu tā zhōng yú dài zhe liú bèi de qī zi zhǎo dào le liú bèi
sentences.english: In the end, he finally found Liu Bei and brought Liu Bei’s wives to him.

sentences.simplified: 这就是关羽“过五关，斩六将”的故事。
sentences.traditional: 這就是關羽“過五關，斬六將”的故事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì guān yǔ guò wǔ guān zhǎn liù jiàng de gù shi
sentences.english: This is the story of Guan Yu “crossing five passes and slaying six generals”.

sentences.simplified: 现在，“过五关，斩六将”是一个成语。
sentences.traditional: 現在，“過五關，斬六將”是一個成語。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài guò wǔ guān zhǎn liù jiàng shì yí ge chéng yǔ
sentences.english: Today, “cross five passes and slay six generals” has become an idiom.

sentences.simplified: 它的字面意思是，过了五个关口，杀了六个大将。
sentences.traditional: 它的字面意思是，過了五個關口，殺了六個大將。
sentences.pinyin: tā de zì miàn yì si shì guò le wǔ ge guān kǒu shā le liù ge dà jiàng
sentences.english: Its literal meaning is that someone passed five checkpoints and killed six generals.

sentences.simplified: 我们用这个成语来说，一个人经过很多难关，最后终于成功了。
sentences.traditional: 我們用這個成語來說，一個人經過很多難關，最後終於成功了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men yòng zhè ge chéng yǔ lái shuō yí ge rén jīng guò hěn duō nán guān zuì hòu zhōng yú chéng gōng le
sentences.english: We use this idiom to describe someone who goes through many difficulties and finally succeeds.

sentences.simplified: 比如，你的朋友在找一份很好的工作。
sentences.traditional: 比如，你的朋友在找一份很好的工作。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú nǐ de péng you zài zhǎo yí fèn hěn hǎo de gōng zuò
sentences.english: For example, your friend is looking for a good job.

sentences.simplified: 他先在网上通过了考试，然后参加了第一次面试，接着是第二次面试，
sentences.traditional: 他先在網上通過了考試，然後參加了第一次面試，接著是第二次面試，
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān zài wǎng shang tōng guò le kǎo shì rán hòu cān jiā le dì yī cì miàn shì jiē zhe shì dì èr cì miàn shì
sentences.english: First, they pass an online test, then attend the first interview, followed by the second interview, ..

sentences.simplified: 最后还和公司的总经理见了面。
sentences.traditional: 最後還和公司的總經理見了面。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu hái hé gōng sī de zǒng jīng lǐ jiàn le miàn
sentences.english: .. and finally meet with the company’s general manager.

sentences.simplified: 他通过了所有这些难关，终于得到了这份工作。
sentences.traditional: 他通過了所有這些難關，終於得到了這份工作。
sentences.pinyin: tā tōng guò le suǒ yǒu zhè xiē nán guān zhōng yú dé dào le zhè fèn gōng zuò
sentences.english: They make it through all these challenges and finally get the job.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，你就可以对他说：“恭喜你！这次找工作，你真是‘过五关，斩六将’啊！”
sentences.traditional: 這時候，你就可以對他說：“恭喜你！這次找工作，你真是‘過五關，斬六將’啊！”
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou nǐ jiù kě yǐ duì tā shuō gōng xǐ nǐ zhè cì zhǎo gōng zuò nǐ zhēn shì guò wǔ guān zhǎn liù jiàng a
sentences.english: At this point, you can say to them, “Congratulations! You really ‘crossed five passes and slayed six generals’!”

sentence_translations: Cross Five Passes and Slay Six Generals
During the Three Kingdoms period, there was a great and powerful hero named Guan Yu.
He worked for the country alongside his “eldest brother” Liu Bei.
One time, they were defeated by Cao Cao, and the two became separated.
Guan Yu was protecting Liu Bei’s wives when they were surrounded by Cao Cao’s men.
Cao Cao greatly admired Guan Yu and wanted Guan Yu to work for him.
However, Guan Yu said, “I only work for my eldest brother Liu Bei.”
Cao Cao said, “You and Liu Bei are separated for now, so work for me in the meantime.
Later when you find out where Liu Bei is, you can go and look for him.”
Guan Yu agreed.
Guan Yu worked for Cao Cao for a while and helped him with many things.
Cao Cao also gave Guan Yu a lot of money, houses, and good horses, hoping that Guan Yu would stay with him forever.
Later, Guan Yu heard that Liu Bei was in a city in the north.
He immediately went to see Cao Cao and said, “I know where my eldest brother is. I’m going to find him.”
Cao Cao said nothing. He was very unwilling in his heart, but he didn’t say “no”.
Guan Yu was worried that Cao Cao would not let him leave, so he did not wait.
He went back to pack his luggage, left a letter for Cao Cao, and then left with Liu Bei’s wives.
They headed north and had to pass through five cities.
These five cities all belonged to Cao Cao, and the defending general of each city followed Cao Cao’s orders.
Each defending general asked Guan Yu, “Do you have a travel pass written by Cao Cao? If not, you cannot pass.”
Cao Cao did not give Guan Yu a travel pass, so Guan Yu could not pass. But he was determined to pass.
The defending generals then started fighting with Guan Yu.
They all wanted to kill Guan Yu, but Guan Yu was too powerful.
None of them could defeat Guan Yu, and in the end, they were all killed by Guan Yu.
Guan Yu passed through five cities and killed six defending generals.
In the end, he finally found Liu Bei and brought Liu Bei’s wives to him.
This is the story of Guan Yu “crossing five passes and slaying six generals”.
Today, “cross five passes and slay six generals” has become an idiom.
Its literal meaning is that someone passed five checkpoints and killed six generals.
We use this idiom to describe someone who goes through many difficulties and finally succeeds.
For example, your friend is looking for a good job.
First, they pass an online test, then attend the first interview, followed by the second interview, ..
.. and finally meet with the company’s general manager.
They make it through all these challenges and finally get the job.
At this point, you can say to them, “Congratulations! You really ‘crossed five passes and slayed six generals’!”
